v2.5.2 (7 August 2026) |feed_title = Story Mode Missions 5-8 |feed_color = Yellow |previous_update = [[v2.4.0|Story Mode Update]] |next_update = [[v2.6.0|Enforcer Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v2.5.0''' is the one hundred and forty-ninth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 7st of August 2026. This update is continuation of the first chapter in [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. This update encompassed three versions, the main v2.5.0 update (released 7 August 2026) and two minor updates, the v2.5.1 (released 7 August 2026) and v2.5.2 (released 7 August 2026). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Golden Mystery]] ===Maps=== *[[Excavation Point]] ===Skins=== *3 new skins for [[Beach Crate]] **{{Color|Beach|Beach}} [[Soldier]] **{{Color|Beach|Beach}} [[Rocketeer]] **{{Color|Beach|Beach}} [[Brawler]] ===Miscellaneous=== *Missions 5-8 released for [[Story Mode]] **''TDS: Origins'' (Chapter 1) ***[[Derailed]] ***[[Rock Bottom]] ***[[Surface Tension]] ***[[The Final Approach]] cutscene ***[[Lights Out]] ***[[Aftermath]] cutscene *[[Trapper (Narrator)|Trapper]] narrator ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Golden Scout]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 0.8 to 0.75. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.8 > 0.5|-0.3}} to {{Tooltip|0.75 > 0.5|-0.25}}. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|2,400}} to {{Money|1,800}}. ****Damage decreased from +29 to +25. ****Range increased from +2.5 to +3. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|3,600}} to {{Money|4,000}}. ****Damage increased from +0 to +6. *[[Golden Soldier]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.15 > 0.125|-0.025}} to {{Tooltip|0.15 > 0.12|-0.03}}. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|3,750}} to {{Money|3,400}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|12,000}} to {{Money|11,350}}. *[[Turret]] buffed in regular modes. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 5''' ****Damage increased from +5 to +11. *Added health scaling to [[Ghost Town]], [[Radio Silence]], [[Off The Rails]] and [[Burning Bridges]] **20% in duo. **40% in trio. **60% in quad. *Updated the [[Soldier (Narrator)|Soldier]]'s, [[Sniper (Narrator)|Sniper]]'s and [[Demoman (Narrator)|Demoman]]'s narrator models to no longer have torn clothes. *Updated camera angles for [[Hops]], [[Soldier (Narrator)|Soldier]], [[Sniper (Narrator)|Sniper]] and [[Demoman (Narrator)|Demoman]] animations. *Updated [[Radio Silence]] dialogue on Wave 6 to refer to the Recruit with gender neutral pronouns. *Updated the cutscene skip UI. *Fixed [[Operator]] having an incorrect coordination radius of 4.75 at Level 4 to 6, now it is 5.5. *Fixed lead detection not working on units unless they dealt a specific damage type that has lead detection by default. *Fixed an issue with [[Revive]]s. *Fixed avatars having disjointed body parts when using R15. *Fixed [[War Machine Sentry]] minigun firing sound muting other sounds while also being very loud. :In '''v2.5.1''': *Version number changed from ''v2.5.0'' to ''v2.5.1''. :In '''v2.5.2''': *Version number changed from ''v2.5.1'' to Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v2.5.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|BeachSkins.png|Story Mode Missions 5-8}} {{UpdateH1|Update Log:}} {{UpdateH2|[[Story Mode]] Missions 5-8 Debut}} {{UpdateGreyText|Continue your journey through [[Story Mode]] with the second installment of Chapter 1.}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Missions 5 - 8 are now available for you and your friends to enjoy, including a brand new map on Mission 7.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|V2.5.0UpdateLog1.png}} {{UpdateWhiteText|We hope you've enjoyed the story so far, and are excited to let you all know that Chapter 2 will come after Halloween. You can expect more news about that in the future.}} {{UpdateH2|New Summer Skins}} {{UpdateGreyText|As summer comes to a close, we're rounding it out with three new summer-themed skins.}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Enjoy the Beach [[Soldier]], Beach [[Rocketeer]] and Beach [[Brawler]] skins. You'll find these in the [[Beach Crate]].}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v2.5.0UpdateLog3.png}} {{UpdateGallery| {{UpdateGalleryItem|BeachCrateIcon.png|Pirate Crate|3,500 Coins or Robux|green}} {{UpdateGalleryItem|BeachSoldierIconIG.png|Soldier|Beach}} {{UpdateGalleryItem|BeachRocketeerIconIG.png|Rocketeer|Beach}} {{UpdateGalleryItem|BeachBrawlerIconIG.png|Brawler|Beach}} }} {{UpdateH2|Lookinga ahead to [[Enforcer]]}} {{UpdateGreyText|Here's a sneak peak of our next Evolved Tower, [[Enforcer]], for you all. We're really eager to see how player's approach [[Enforcer]]'s unique skillset. [[Enforcer]] is an all-arounder: He has a shotgun with spread, is capable of bringing vehicles onto the battlefield, and is able to flashbang enemies to efficiently stun enemies.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v2.5.0UpdateLog2.png}} {{UpdateWhiteText|You'll get your hands on him this time exactly 1 week from today.}} {{UpdateH1|Game Changes:}} *Polished up [[Story Mode]] dialog characters. *Fixed avatars glitching during cutscenes. *Fixed [[Sentry]] audio bugs. *Added Vote Skip to cutscenes. *Added health scaling to [[Story Mode|story mode]] waves. *[[Revive|Revive ticket]] hotfix. }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v2.5.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
